summary:
Ground truth is origin/main 15e78e276. All paths below are relative to /Users/slimydog/Antiek/platform/.claude/worktrees/ground-main-20260924. Proof scripts are in /tmp/mothership-ground/shell-workstations/proof/.

Today the app organises work by workflow and route. It has no notion of a project or workstation. One AppShell (apps/reading/src/AppShell.tsx:68-201) wraps every authenticated route: Topbar breadcrumbs, a SceneChrome action bar with static view tabs for each workflow, one Zustand panel workspace (docks left, right and bottom, floating panels, popout), a separate in-memory layer of up to 8 "workspace windows", a bottom NavRail with four doors (Research ⌘J, Read ⌘E, Write ⌘Y, Speak ⌘U) plus Home ⌘O and More ⌘I, a ⌘K palette, a `?` hotkey HUD and a floating mascot that opens a "project tree". That tree is scoped to the current workflow's nouns, not to a project. Research and Write are separate route families (/, /inv/:id, /deep-research vs /write/:id, /create) inside the same shell. Clicking a door always goes to that workflow's default route, so switching workflows loses your place.

Against herdr (session > workspaces > tabs > panes, a sidebar of spaces and agents with state, prefix+1..9 and a workspace picker, resume on restore, toast/sound/system notifications): Antiek has the pane layer (panel docks and floats, ⌘[/⌘] focus cycling, popout) and part of the attention layer. The herdr transfer P0 shipped in #3078: a state registry, rollup, unseen axis, clickable toasts and state: chips in the palette. The workspace and tab layers are missing entirely, and so is any hotkey for them. The follow-up P1 (#3088: completion sound, window-title status) and P2 (#3092: favicon dot, layout presets) PRs have been OPEN and unmerged since 2026-08-14.

Four defects matter before anyone builds on this shell. I proved the first three by running the real main modules (bundled with esbuild, run under jsdom with react 18.3.1, react-router 6.30.6 and zustand 5.0.15 borrowed from the design-audit worktree's node_modules, since main has no node_modules):

1. ⌘K does not open the palette unless focus is in a text field. CommandPalette's own keydown handler and the shell's PALETTE_TOGGLE event both flip the state, so they cancel out. The NavRail Search button and ⌘⇧P still work.
2. On fresh storage, AppShell's hydration effect runs after the route's PanelHost starters open (React fires child effects first) and wipes them. The investigation sidebar and chat do not dock on /inv/:id.
3. AppShell calls useParams outside the inner <Routes>, so it gets {"*":"inv/abc123"} and never sees investigationId. The per-investigation layout scope is never read or written. All investigations share the key "antiek.workspace.route./inv/:id", and the palette's "Reset layout (this investigation)" clears a key that is never written.
4. The single-⌘+key space is used up: 0 plain ⌘+letter combos are free, and ⌘1..9 are reserved for the browser. SPR-08 banned leader keys and chords. Number-hopping between workstations therefore needs a key-scheme decision before any code is written. Also, `comboSpecFor` reads `e.key`, which on macOS turns ⌥1 into "¡" (an OS behaviour I did not run in a browser).

On the backend, the only project-like records are speak_projects, interview_projects, write_folders (collections of blocks that span investigations, stored as membership edges rather than copies), deliverables.investigation_root_id, and parent_investigation_id research families. Research sessions can only be fetched one at a time (GET /research/sessions/{id}); there is no list endpoint. There is no attention or inbox table.

The operator's live herdr has 20 workspaces and 252 tabs, one workspace alone has 174 tabs, and nearly every tab is a single pane. So the tab layer carries the load, and it needs overflow handling and a fuzzy go-to on top of 1..9.

capabilities.name: Workstation = project entity (frontend state + backend record)

evidence.note: zero matches: no active-project or workstation store exists
the comment says 'exactly ONE Mascot, always representing the ACTIVE project', but a double-click just runs navigate('/home'); no project id is involved
/home, the so-called project home, is a static landing page with four doors
the 'project tree' is scoped to the active WORKFLOW's nouns, not to a project
write_folders + write_folder_members: collections of blocks spanning investigations, stored as membership edges ('views/edges over graph nodes, not copies'); folder writes emit no typed events
deliverables.investigation_root_id links one Write piece to one research root
speak_projects / interview_projects are the only tables named 'project'; both are Speak-only

evidence.ref: git grep for '"/(projects?|folders?|workspaces?|workstations?)' routes in interfaces/
evidence.note: only /speak/projects* and /write/folders* exist; no workspace or workstation API

capabilities.gap: Needs a first-class Workstation. Backend: a `workstations` table (workstation_id, owner_user_id DEFAULT '__operator__', title, created_at, updated_at, archived_at, metadata) and `workstation_members` (workstation_id, member_kind IN ('investigation','drw_session','document','deliverable','notebook','write_folder','thread'), member_id, added_at, PK(workstation_id, member_kind, member_id)). Membership must be edges, never copies, following the write_folders precedent. It needs typed WorkstationCreated/MemberAdded/MemberRemoved event payloads in substrate/schemas/events.py, and all writes must go through runtime/db_lock. Endpoints: GET/POST /workstations, GET/PATCH /workstations/{id}, POST/DELETE /workstations/{id}/members. Frontend: a route prefix /w/:workstationId/* and a `useWorkstations` store holding the active workstation id. Research families (parent_investigation_id roots) and deliverables with investigation_root_id could be proposed as starter workstations.

capabilities.name: Multiple open workstations held at once

evidence.note: one route tree and one active route; no container for several open workstations
the only in-app multiplicity: up to 8 workspace windows (MAX_WINDOWS = 8), memory only, gone on reload
only 5 page kinds can live in a window (stats, library, subaction, researchArtifactReceipt, reader); ResearchWorkstation and WrestleApp are explicitly out of contract (openWindow.ts:36-47)
/_panel/:panelId popout OS windows over BroadcastChannel are per panel, not per workstation

capabilities.gap: Needs an `openWorkstations: WorkstationId[]` list plus `activeWorkstationId`. Each open workstation keeps its own last route, tab list, focused tab and panel layout, and switching preserves them (herdr's workspace carries active_tab_id). Browser tabs are the only real workaround today, and all of them share one localStorage namespace.

capabilities.name: Tabs within a workstation (open objects: docs, researches, pieces, threads)

evidence.note: 'tabs' are STATIC per-workflow route links (Workstation / My research / Outcomes; Library / Documents / Notebooks; Projects / Interviews), not open objects
tabActive matches '/' exactly, so on /inv/:id no Research tab is marked active
viewed: none of the three tabs is underlined on /inv/demo-investigation
only filter/settings tablists (Library, Settings, SpeakIndex, LibraryView); there is no tab strip of open objects anywhere

capabilities.gap: Needs a `WorkstationTab` model {tab_id, workstation_id, kind: 'investigation'|'drw_session'|'reader'|'deliverable'|'notebook'|'thread', entity_id, route, title, pinned, last_focused_at, attention}. It needs a tab strip in the SceneChrome zone with overflow and a fuzzy go-to (the operator has one herdr workspace with 174 tabs), plus open/close/reorder/rename. The existing '/' SceneChrome view tabs should be demoted or folded in. Decide first whether windowsStore windows ARE tabs: the STRATEGY-TRANSFER doc warns 'do not create a third concept blindly'.

capabilities.name: Hotkey hop between workstations (herdr prefix+shift+1..9 / workspace_picker prefix+w)

evidence.note: global bindings are ⌘K, ⌘⇧P, ⌘B, ⌘/, ⌘[, ⌘], ⌘W and ?, plus 6 products and 2 sub-actions; no workstation or tab bindings
RESERVED_COMBOS includes ⌘1..⌘9 and ⌘0 (browser tab jump / zoom)

evidence.ref: python3 over bindings.ts (RESERVED_COMBOS minus owned specs)
evidence.note: output: FREE plain mod+letter: [] ; FREE mod+punct: [',', '.', "'"]. The single-⌘ key space is exhausted
SPR-08 removed all leader and chord machinery by operator ratification
'Inventing a brand-new modifier scheme (Leader keys, ⌥-prefixed namespaces, a command-mode)' is excluded: the operator asked for ⌘+key
comboSpecFor builds the spec from e.key. On macOS ⌥+1 yields e.key '¡' (platform behaviour, NOT MEASURED in a browser), so an 'alt+1' binding could never match; digit bindings must use e.code
herdr defaults: prefix ctrl+b, workspace_picker prefix+w, goto prefix+g, switch_tab prefix+1..9, next/prev tab prefix+n/p, switch_workspace optional prefix+shift+1..9

capabilities.gap: The key scheme must be decided before any code, because it conflicts with the ratified SPR-08 no-chord rule. Options: (a) ratify one leader key (e.g. ctrl+b like herdr, or ⌘; which is currently the Read-library sub-action) with a visible prefix-mode HUD, then 1..9 for tabs, shift+1..9 for workstations, w for the picker, g for go-to, n/p for next/prev; (b) ⌥/⌃+digit resolved from e.code (Digit1..9), which needs a comboSpecFor change; (c) ⌘⇧+digit (check each browser). Whichever wins needs a new `WORKSTATION_BINDINGS` table in bindings.ts, conflict entries, HUD rows and a picker modal. The shortcuts.ts handler must add a digit branch based on e.code.

capabilities.name: Hotkey hop between tabs / panes inside a workstation

windows have no keyboard verbs (no focus-next, close or expand keys)

capabilities.gap: No tab layer exists to hop between. Panel focus cycling works (pane level). Needed: next/prev tab, switch to tab N, a recent-tab toggle (herdr last_pane), close tab, reopen closed tab; window focus cycling should join the same ring.

capabilities.name: Sidebar listing workstations/agents/threads with live state

a Research door badge counts research families that need attention, polled every 60 s
'blocked' only means status=failed; there is no awaiting-input or needs-approval state

output: child effect opened ['InvestigationSidebar:default'], then AFTER MOUNT dockLeftIds = [] and panels = []. Hydration wipes the sidebar starter on fresh storage

capabilities.gap: Needs a shell-level, always-available sidebar (not a Research-only panel). It should list open workstations with a rolled-up state, then their agents and threads: DRW sessions (needs GET /research/sessions?owner&state), investigations, thread-partner and anchored-comment agent_work threads, and Write generation jobs. Each row needs a state from ONE registry, extended with an 'awaiting_input' state for plan approvals, spend approvals and agent questions. The sidebar should subscribe to /ws/events (today no shell-level event consumer exists: git grep useEventStream finds only Replay, StartResearch, WrestleApp and the hooks) instead of 30 s polls that stop when the tab is hidden. It needs a spaces/priority sort like herdr's agent_panel_sort.

evidence.note: localStorage scopes global / route.<key> / inv.<id>, plus a one-shot ?ws= URL (useWorkspaceHydration.ts:87-92)
output: AppShell useParams() = {"*":"inv/abc123"}; route leaf = {..., investigationId:'abc123'}; AppShell investigationId = null (useWorkspaceHydration.ts:51-52 runs in AppShell.tsx:99)

capabilities.gap: Needs a server-backed session (per owner: open workstations, each with tabs, active tab, last route and panel layout), so state follows the operator across devices the way herdr resume does. localStorage can stay as a cache. Fix the hydration scope first: read investigationId from matchPath(location.pathname) rather than useParams at shell level. Also fix the ordering: hydrate in a layout effect or before PanelHost starters mount, or make starters idempotent re-openers after hydration. Persist windows (the named follow-up in windowsStore.ts:57-60) and pins. Add a per-workflow and per-workstation last-route memory.

capabilities.name: Unified Research + Write shell (one mothership)

Research (/, /inv/:id, /deep-research/:sessionId) and Write (/write/:deliverableId, /create/:id) are separate route families with no shared context object

capabilities.gap: One shell, but two products. To become a mothership, a workstation must hold research runs AND written pieces as tabs side by side, with the reader able to open inside either (WINDOW_PAGES.reader already exists as a window kind). The workflow doors become lenses on the active workstation rather than separate destinations.

Then add entity kinds: workstations, open tabs, deliverables (GET /write/deliverables), Speak projects, DRW sessions, threads and claims. Add MRU ordering on an empty query, a 'switch to workstation / open as tab / open in window' secondary action, and match reasons.

craft_gaps: ⌘K, the primary switcher key, does nothing unless focus is in a text field (RUN, palette2.tsx case C). This is the first thing a keyboard-first user presses; ⌘⇧P and the NavRail Search button work.
Clicking a door throws away your place: Research→Write→Research lands on '/' rather than the open investigation (NavRail.tsx:304-311). In herdr every workspace remembers its active tab.

/home is misclassified as Research. It shows the Research action bar ('New investigation', 'Ask', 'Outcomes') and view tabs, and highlights the Research door (workflowTaxonomy.ts:741-761 has no /home entry).
On /inv/:id none of the Research view tabs reads as active, because the check is an exact '/' match (SceneChrome.tsx:180-181; visible in route-authmock-inv-demo-investigation__light__1280.png).
The ProjectTree's Write and Speak 'Recent' sections always say 'No recent items yet.' even when deliverables exist (ProjectTree.tsx:169-176,247-250). That empty state is untrue.

The ProjectTree uses its own status vocabulary (stopped counts as 'done', ProjectTree.tsx:88-99) and emoji icons (📄, ProjectTree.tsx:337-341), drifting from the shared researchState registry that the herdr transfer made canonical.

Breadcrumbs show raw route slugs and UUIDs, e.g. 'Investigation › demo-investigation' (Topbar.tsx:28-74). The account button is an emoji 👤 (Topbar.tsx:125). Both are addressed on unmerged design/w3-shell-states-prose-20260923.

Palette route subtitles leak internal taxonomy ('Mode A — chat-first investigation surface', 'Wedge 2…'; CommandPalette.tsx:131-265). An empty query shows routes in declaration order with no recent items, and a miss is a dead-end 'No matches.' (CommandPalette.tsx:839).
Pins disappear on reload (pinnedStore.ts:6-8), which breaks the promise the ★ affordance makes.

The nested PanelLayout (AppShell.tsx:151 + PanelHost.tsx:79) renders the narrow-viewport banner twice (design-audit visual-critiques F-13) and is a candidate cause of the starter panels that go missing.
Starter docks (the investigation sidebar and the per-investigation chat) do not appear on first visit (RUN, entry.tsx), so the Research workstation's own frame is missing.
Two independent keydown owners claim ⌘J when the AI sidecar is open (AISidecar.tsx:190-199 vs bindings.ts:330). Pressing it navigates away from the page and also fires an event nothing listens to.
The mascot sits above panels and windows (z=60; design-audit SCORE-BASELINE-full.md:65) and can cover exactly the region where a tab strip or sidebar would go.

Backgrounded tabs go silent. The investigation poll pauses while document.visibilityState is hidden (useInvestigationList.ts:51-60), so nothing tells you a research finished while you were elsewhere: no title, no favicon, no sound, no notification.
risks: The key scheme conflicts with a ratified decision. SPR-08 removed chords and leader keys at the operator's request, the plain ⌘+letter space has 0 free keys (RUN), and ⌘1..9 belong to the browser. A herdr-style prefix or number-hop scheme needs an explicit operator re-ratification, or a different modifier family resolved from e.code. Building first and asking later would repeat the v1 'invisible' failure.

Any new tab or workstation layer built on WorkspaceStore inherits two proven defects: the hydration effect runs after the route's starters and wipes them, and the shell-level useParams never sees :investigationId. Fix both first, or per-workstation layouts will silently collapse into one route-wide key.

Three layout models would coexist: WorkspaceStore panels, windowsStore windows, and a new tabs model. The 2026-08-13 transfer doc already warned 'do not create a third concept blindly'. Merge windows into tabs, or define tabs as views over one store.

In-flight collisions: design/w3-shell-states-prose-20260923 (NavRail, Topbar, SceneChrome, PanelLayout, MascotStation), design/w5-motion-20260923 (PanelLayout, MascotStation), design/w7-crashes-20260924 (App.tsx, PanelLayout) and the stale herdr PRs #3088/#3092 (AppShell, PanelLayout, NavRail, WorkspaceStore, useWorkspaceHydration) all edit the exact files a mothership shell must own.

A backend workstation entity touches the DuckDB single-writer invariant. Membership writes must go through runtime/db_lock, and folders.py notes that no typed folder event payloads exist, so workstation events need registered payload types (untyped payloads under typed names are prohibited).

Scale: the operator's live herdr has 20 workspaces and 252 tabs, one workspace with 174 (RUN: herdr workspace list). A naive tab strip or 1..9-only hopping will fail at that scale. Overflow, a fuzzy go-to and an attention-sorted view are required from day one.

State is local to the device. Layout, seen state, custom hotkeys and pins live in localStorage or memory, so a mothership session would not follow the operator across machines the way herdr's resume and resurrect do. A server-side session must respect the single-operator-until-Sprint-22 invariant.

The ⌘K and hydration findings come from a jsdom harness using react 18.3.1, react-router 6.30.6 and zustand 5.0.15 from the design-audit worktree's node_modules, run against main's source files. Their real-browser behaviour was NOT MEASURED, although the mechanism (two toggles batched in one event; React runs child effects before the parent's) does not depend on the browser.

Will the operator re-ratify a leader or prefix key (e.g. ctrl+b or ⌘; with a visible prefix-mode HUD) despite the SPR-08 ban on chords and leader keys? Or should workstation and tab hopping use ⌥/⌃+digit resolved from e.code? Which one?
Are tabs URL-backed (each tab a route, the address bar shows the active tab) or store-backed with only the active tab in the URL? How do browser back/forward interact with tab switching?

Should windowsStore windows become tabs, or stay as floating companions inside a tab? And should the four workflow doors survive as lenses on the active workstation or be replaced by the workstation sidebar?
Should Read and Speak objects also be workstation tabs, or only Research and Write, with Read embedded everywhere via the reader window?
Should the session be persisted server-side per owner, or is localStorage acceptable for v1 given single-operator use across Mac mini, laptop and iPad?

Which notification channels are in scope (in-app toast, document.title, favicon, sound, OS Notification API), and what are the suppression rules? Should #3088/#3092 be rebased and landed, or superseded?
